title: Managing Apps
summary: Managing Apps in the Admin Center provides unified control for Global Apps, Per-Tenant Extensions, and DEV extensions, including installation, updates, scheduling, dependency resolution, and uninstallation across business central environments.
features: Manage Apps page in Admin Center
App update management with version compatibility
Apps Update Cadence setting for automatic updates
Deployment scheduling (immediate, update window, minor/major version)
App uninstallation with data deletion options
